sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球跨境基金设立第一大国、超大型跨国投资架构

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Wholesale Distribution of Clinical Diagnostic ELISA Assays and Reagents

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Multilateral Convention to Implement Tax Treaty Related Measures (BEPS MLI)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law of 12 November 2004 on the fight against money laundering and terrorist financing, as amended; Law of 13 January 2019 establishing the Register of Beneficial Owners; Law of 10 August 1915 on commercial companies, as amended (Art. 101-1 et seq.).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport of each general partner and each ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or consular authority in country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good standing / excerpt from company register of each corporate general partner
Capital-proof and source-of-funds statement for initial contribution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Partner's bank or qualified financial institution

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all partners and beneficial owners against PEP lists, OFAC SDN, EU/UN sanctions, Luxembourg MEF, World Bank and domestic judicial databases; enhanced due diligence mandatory when any subject is PEP, negative press, or sanctioned jurisdiction; ongoing transaction monitoring for beneficial-owner changes.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) – Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés online eRegistration portal ePermission
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company name must be in Latin script and may use French, German, English or Luxembourgish; for SCSp the name must be preceded or followed by 'Société en Commandite Spéciale' or 'SCSp'; name must be clearly distinguishable from existing names in the RCS; no transliteration doctrine if the registered name is in Latin letters.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the proposed name is rejected, the applicant receives an official refusal from the RCS. Within 30 days the applicant may file a written administrative appeal with the Chamber of Commerce (Chambre de Commerce) and/or the Minister of Justice, accompanied by the reservation reference, legal arguments, and any evidence of prior usage; a final appeal lies before the administrative court under the Grand-Ducal regulation of 2017.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual-office addresses are not accepted as statutory registered office for an SCSp under Luxembourg law; the registered office must be a real location in Luxembourg, but commercial domiciliation agents are permitted and may be used by non-resident general partners.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low with a quantified statistical baseline of <5% annual probability for low-risk wholesale distribution activities; inspection probability rises above 10% where the entity appears on a sanctions or PEP list or where UBO transparency data is missing.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Heads of Terms Preparation and Legal Due Diligence (cross-border) by corporate counsel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External corporate law firm / legal counsel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark/hourly cross-border corporate fee
Statutory fee in RCS tariff schedule. The reservation will be made via eRegistration; fee is set in LBR fee decree and subject to change.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarial and apostille/legalization of partner passports and corporate documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff per notary law plus apostille fees under Hague Convention

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/PEP and Sanctions Screening of UBOs and partners
UBO Registration filing with RBE (RBE declaration)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under RBE regulation (one-time filing fee).

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Domiciliation service provider licensed in Luxembourg

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law of 10 August 1915 on Commercial Companies, as amended, Title on Special Limited Partnerships (société en commandite spéciale – SCSp), Articles 944-1 to 944-25; supplemented by the Luxembourg Civil Code and the Law of 19 December 2002 on the Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register and Repealing the Trade Register
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (RCS – Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés), managed by Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Notarized deed of partnership (acte de société) together with the application for RCS registration (demande d'immatriculation) submitted through the notary or registered attorney
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum legal or paid-up capital is required for an SCSp; the partnership agreement freely determines the amount and payment schedule of capital contributions. Where contributions are agreed to be paid up, funds may be placed in an escrow or dedicated bank account pending RCS registration, but no statutory escrow requirement exists.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED THAT: (1) the subscriptions to partnership interests as set out in the approved subscription schedule are hereby accepted, effective upon formation, with initial contributions as stated in the partnership agreement; (2) the registered office of the SCSp is established at the address specified in the partnership agreement, and the general partner is authorized to file all registration documents with the Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register and any other competent authority; (3) the manager(s) designated in the partnership agreement are appointed to act with full power to execute, file, and complete all formation, licensing, banking, and tax formalities; and (4) any one such officer may sign all required declarations and forms.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Prepare and Notarize the SCSp Partnership Deed
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg notary (formation formal act) and Luxembourg Business Registers (RCS) as the receiving registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the full partnership agreement (contrat de société) containing the corporate name, legal form, registered office address, duration, share/partnership interest classes, subscription commitments, contribution obligations, rights attached to partnership interests, transfer restrictions, management and representation powers, financial year, liquidation clauses, and governing Luxembourg law. Execute the deed before a licensed Luxembourg notary, who verifies legal capacity, availability of the name, and compliance with Luxembourg mandatory rules.
required_dossiers: Draft partnership agreement (acte de société)
Identity documents (passport, proof of address) of all partners and intended managers
Power of attorney for the representative executing the deed if not present
Reservation or confirmation of the proposed SCSp name
KYC file of each beneficial owner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or RCS name search identifies deficiencies or a name conflict, correct the deed and resubmit within 5 business days; any missing supporting document may be provided via supplemental notarial annex.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Open Bank Account and Subscribe Initial Partnership Interests
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg licensed credit institution cooperating with the formation counsel
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a dedicated account in the name of the future SCSp for subscription payments. Implement the capital subscription schedule set out in the partnership deed or internal schedule. Where contributions are to be made in cash and not immediately required, deposit funds in escrow or in a blocked account until RCS registration. Obtain an official banker's confirmation or deposit receipt identifying the SCSp and the subscribed amounts.
required_dossiers: Notarized draft partnership deed
Identification and KYC of all shareholders/partners and managers
Bank account opening forms and beneficial ownership declarations
Proof of payment or proof of availability of funds
Power of attorney for bank representatives
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests enhanced diligence, file a revised KYC package with a legal analysis of the SCSp structure and beneficial owners within 5 business days; alternatively appoint a local trustee or nominate a third-party service provider.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File Application with Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register (RCS)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (RCS – Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés), Luxembourg
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the notarized partnership deed and the electronic application for registration through the RCS electronic filing portal, or via the notary's electronic authentication. The application must include the entity name, registered office, legal form, duration, object, capital subscriptions, identity of managers and their powers, and the names of persons authorized to bind the entity. Pay the applicable registry fee and obtain the RCS registration number, legal entity identifier, and registration extract.
required_dossiers: Notarized partnership deed (acte de société)
RCS application form (demande d'immatriculation)
Evidence of paid contributions or bank confirmation
Beneficial owner identification and declarations
Statement of acceptance by the appointed managers/officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RCS issues a query or refusal, the notary or attorney shall submit a corrective certificate, amended deed, or missing declaration within 10 business days; urgent rectification may be requested through the RCS helpdesk.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Recueil Électronique des Sociétés et Associations (RESA), operated by Luxembourg Business Registers
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After RCS registration, file the legally required extracts for publication in the official electronic gazette (RESA), including the formation date, registered office, object, partnership form, registered capital/contributions, and authorized managers. The publication makes the formation effective in relation to third parties and confirms legal publicity of the SCSp.
required_dossiers: Registration extract (extrait RCS)
Publication request form
Certified copy of the notarized partnership deed
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the publication is interrupted or rejected due to incomplete particulars, correct the data and refile within 10 business days; request an expedited re-publication if a regulatory counterparty requires immediate evidence.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Complete Post-Registration Governance, Appointment and Beneficial Ownership Filings
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg RCS Beneficial Ownership Register (Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs – RBE), Luxembourg tax authority (Administration des contributions directes), VAT authority (Administration de l'enregistrement et des domaines), and social security office (Centre commun de la sécurité sociale)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Finalize the internal governance records, issue the appointment certificates for managers, certify signatures, and open or activate the entity's bank account under its RCS number. File the beneficial ownership declaration with the RBE within the legal deadline. Register additional data with the tax and social security administrations, including VAT identification and any required preliminary employment registrations.
required_dossiers: Certified RCS registration extract
Manager appointment resolutions and acceptance letters
Bank account opening documentation with final RCS number
Beneficial ownership filing draft
VAT registration form and supporting corporate documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RBE or tax authority queries the beneficial ownership data, furnish a corrected beneficial ownership declaration and supporting legal memorandum within 5 business days; for delays in VAT registration, request the issuance of a temporary VAT number for customs interoperability.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Luxembourg Ministry of Health (Direction de la Santé), Division of Pharmacy and Medicines (Division de la Pharmacie et des Médicaments), acting under Regulation (EU) 2017/746 on in vitro diagnostic medical devices and the national Medical Devices Act
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Wholesale Distribution Authorization for In Vitro Diagnostic Medical Devices (including ELISA assay reagents and clinical diagnostic kits)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Registration/Declaration tier (no full environmental impact assessment report), provided the warehouse storage of diagnostic reagents does not exceed thresholds for dangerous substances; otherwise a Category 'C' environmental notification is required under the Luxembourg environmental impact assessment legislation
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater process discharge from warehousing and distribution activities; sanitary wastewater must comply with communal discharge ordinances. Storage areas for solvent-based reagents, buffers, and positive-control materials must comply with VOC emission limits under Directive 2004/42/EC where applicable, and waste handling must segregate hazardous chemical and biological waste in accordance with the Luxembourg Waste Management Act and the European Waste Catalogue.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate issued by the Grand Ducal Fire and Rescue Corps (Corps grand-ducal d'incendie et de secours – CGDIS); compliance with structural load and occupancy requirements as certified by the competent communal building authority; workplace health and safety clearance from the Labour and Mines Inspectorate (Inspection du Travail et des Mines – ITM), including handling protocols for clinical laboratory reagents and risk assessment documents.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Administration des contributions directes (ACD) for income and corporate taxes; Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT) for VAT and registration duties. Unified filing and portal access is provided through MyGuichet.lu / Guichet.lu; statutory company registration is lodged with the Luxembourg Business Registers (RCS) and published in the Recueil électronique des sociétés et associations (RESA).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned SCSp must (1) execute and file the partnership agreement with the RCS to obtain the national business matricule number; (2) register for Luxembourg VAT with the AEDT using Form 642/643, accompanied by the RCS excerpt, partnership agreement, proof of Luxembourg establishment, evidence of the intended taxable activity (wholesale distribution of clinical diagnostic ELISA assays and reagents under ISIC 4649), and bank reference data; and (3) where applicable, file a VAT group election or small-business exemption election. The AEDT issues the Luxembourg VAT identification number (format LU + 8 digits), also entered in the EU VIES database. Non-resident partners generally do not require a separate Luxembourg TIN for the transparent partnership itself; the SCSp may act as VAT taxable person and, if needed, as withholding agent for Luxembourg-source amounts.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Pass_Through_Eligible. The SCSp is fiscally transparent for Luxembourg direct tax purposes: it is not subject to Luxembourg corporate income tax, municipal business tax, or net wealth tax. Partnership income and gains are allocated to and taxable at the hands of the partners in accordance with the partnership agreement and applicable tax treaties. For VAT purposes the SCSp may nevertheless be treated as a distinct taxable person when it carries on an economic activity, such as the commercial distribution of diagnostic reagents, and must register and comply with VAT obligations separately.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Luxembourg does not operate a US-style check-the-box regime. The SCSp's transparent classification is statutory and confirmed by advance tax ruling where necessary. Available elections and mechanisms include: (i) the election to apply the Luxembourg VAT grouping (assujetti unique) regime under Article 63 of the VAT law, subject to control and financial integration conditions; (ii) the small-business exemption election if annual taxable turnover is below EUR 35,000, unless mandatory registration applies; (iii) the option to renounce the exemption for small businesses to standard-rate supplies; (iv) contractual allocation of taxable profits and losses among partners, provided the allocation has economic substance and complies with the general anti-abuse rule; and (v) alignment of the partnership's treatment with hybrid-mismatch rules under the EU ATAD as implemented in Luxembourg, whereby the jurisdiction of establishment of the partners determines the transparency effect.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Taxe sur la valeur ajoutée, TVA) under the EU common VAT system
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EUR 35,000 (annual taxable turnover excluding VAT). The small-business exemption applies below this threshold, but mandatory VAT registration exists from the first euro where the business makes intra-EU acquisitions, distance sales into Luxembourg, imports, or supplies of certain services to non-established taxable persons; wholesale distribution of diagnostic reagents in the ordinary course of business will normally require VAT registration regardless of threshold once the activity is regular and profitable.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Luxembourg does not currently mandate real-time clearance, continuous transaction controls, or digital fiscal stamping for domestic B2B invoicing. Invoicing under the VAT law still permits paper or PDF/PDF-composite formats, subject to correct issuance and archiving. Mandatory electronic invoicing applies only in B2G transactions for supplies to Luxembourg public authorities, requiring PEPPOL BIS Billing 3.0 XML through certified access points. VAT returns and recapitulative statements (EU sales lists) must be filed electronically via the AEDT e-filing portal (eCDF / MyGuichet.lu). Export transactions must be reported and maintained in the VIES-bound periodic declarations; documentary retention of at least 10 years is recommended for zero-rated export proof.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating is available for supplies of goods physically dispatched or transported to a destination outside the European Union (export supplies) and for intra-Community supplies to a VAT-registered customer in another EU Member State. The SCSp must demonstrate that ownership and transport risk have passed to the foreign buyer and that the goods left Luxembourg/EU territory. Standard commercial evidence includes the customs export declaration validated by customs, transport documents (CMR, bill of lading, or airway bill), sales contract and invoice, and proof of payment from the foreign customer. For diagnostic reagents distributed to non-EU laboratories, the export is zero-rated only if the customs formalities are completed in the name of the supplier and the supplier retains the authenticated export proof; if the customer acts as exporter, the supplier must obtain and retain the customer's export declaration.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (SAD / Single Administrative Document submitted via Luxembourg customs systems) with customs exit confirmation
Bill of Lading, CMR consignment note, or air waybill evidencing physical dispatch and destination outside the European Union
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank payment instruction demonstrating receipt of foreign currency proceeds from the overseas buyer
Commercial invoice with a clear zero-rating statement, Incoterms, and description of the IVD diagnostic reagents
Sales order, delivery note, packing list, and any certificates of analysis or compliance relevant to the underlying transaction
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The AEDT and Luxembourg customs authorities perform targeted audits of export zero-rating claims, especially for high-value or high-risk invoices. If the exporter fails to produce complete and consistent proof within the audit window, VAT is retrospectively assessed at 17% plus statutory late interest. Administrative fines may reach 150% of the evaded amount, and criminal proceedings for fraudulent zero-rating can result in fines up to EUR 25,000 and imprisonment for up to five years, or both. The fiscal clawback statute of limitation is generally five years, extended to ten years when fraud or deliberate concealment is established; the burden of substantiation rests on the supplier and must be retained for the full statutory record-keeping period.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque centrale du Luxembourg (BCL), with the Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier (CSSF) exercising joint supervision over credit institutions, anti-money-laundering, and foreign-exchange related conduct.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The euro is fully convertible. Both capital and current account transactions are unrestricted under Articles 63-66 TFEU as transposed into Luxembourg law; no foreign-exchange authorisation, capital permit, or central bank approval is required for profit remittance from a Luxembourg SCSp. The practical obstacles are limited to full AML/KYC documentation on ultimate beneficial owners and the obligation to demonstrate genuine economic substance sufficient for banking due diligence. An SCSp is pass-through for tax purposes, so no Luxembourg withholding arises on distributions to non-resident partners absent specific treaty base-erosion triggers.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Luxembourg imposes no mandatory repatriation timeline, no surrender percentage, and no forced conversion of export receipts into euros. Receivables from the cross-border distribution of IVD reagents may be retained in any convertible currency; exporters need only comply with BCL balance-of-payments statistical reporting where aggregate flows exceed the applicable monthly threshold.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account / FX and Trade Settlement Account
Operational Account / Wealth and Partnership Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium feasibility. A CSSF-licensed payment or e-money institution, or an EU-passported EMI, can provide multi-currency transaction accounts, FX conversion, and open-API treasury automation aligned with the SCSp's payment waterfall. However, Luxembourg credit institutions generally do not treat EMI-held float as bank-grade collateral or escrow-grade liquidity, and the legal framework requires strict PSD2 pass-porting, safeguarding of partnership funds, and CSSF-compliant AML/CFT outsourcing if the EMI interfaces with regulated client monies.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In practice at least one general-partner director and every ultimate beneficial owner holding 25% or more of the SCSp must attend either a physical interview at the Luxembourg branch or a videoconference identification session conducted under a CSSF-accepted remote-KYC protocol with notarised corporate excerpts. Pure wire-only, no-interview remote opening is effectively unavailable. For non-resident principals, a formal introduction letter from their home-country relationship banker materially accelerates the process.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-EU ultimate beneficial owner concealed behind a multi-layered SCSp ownership chain.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full organisational chart; RCS (Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register) excerpt for the SCSp and general partner; Luxembourg beneficial-owner register filing receipt; FATCA and CRS self-certification for every UBO; passport, tax identification number, and current proof of residence for each direct or indirect owner.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Low substance and unclearly justified source of wealth in cross-border reagent distribution.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Three years of audited partnership financial statements; bank reference letters from the principals' existing foreign banks; source-of-wealth file comprising signed distribution contracts, supplier invoices, warehouse or fulfilment agreements, and personal tax assessments; structured mapping of the end-to-end IVD supply chain and ultimate hospital or laboratory buyers.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Regulatory licensing exposure for clinical diagnostic reagents (IVD class A/B under EU Regulation 2017/746).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid Luxembourg distributor declaration and importer notification under Regulation (EU) 2017/746, including the entity's registration with the competent Ministry of Health authority, EUDAMED references for the distributed assays, evidence of a compliant quality-management system, and product-liability insurance certificate.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Injections arrive by authenticated SWIFT or SEPA Instant wire into the SCSp's dedicated euro operating account at a Luxembourg credit institution. Wires must carry the BCL balance-of-payments direct-investment capital contribution purpose code, and commercial banks may require a copy of the contribution notice or partnership agreement extract. USD injections must state 'Capital Investment' or equivalent purpose flag, with no FX license or central bank permit needed; only the standard BCL statistical declaration applies when monthly cross-border flows exceed the reporting threshold.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Preferred rail: SWIFT MT103 priority transfers to the supplier's account, with each payment carrying the goods-purchase transaction purpose code matching ISIC 4649 orders. For stock procurement on extended terms, irrevocable commercial letters of credit under UCP600 issued by the Luxembourg relationship bank are fully permissible, as are documentary collections (DP/DA) and SEPA Credit Transfers for EU counterparties. Each disbursement should be supported by the purchase order, commercial invoice, and bill of lading to maintain customs and tax audit alignment.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: EUR-CNY non-deliverable forwards (NDF) for settlements involving Chinese reagent manufacturers
EUR-JPY and EUR-GBP FX swaps for trade-stock payment cycles
Cross-currency interest rate swaps governed by ISDA 2002 under Luxembourg law
Vanilla FX options on CSSF-authorized dealers only; leveraged NDF or options on unlicensed retail platforms are prohibited

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual RCS identity confirmation (annual renewal/confirmation of registered company particulars)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers – Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within one month of the anniversary of the SCSp's RCS registration date; all registered particulars must be confirmed as current or formally updated in the same filing.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to submit the annual confirmation triggers late-filing penalties and formal warnings; prolonged non-compliance can lead to administrative strike-off of the RCS registration and loss of Luxembourg corporate benefits.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual beneficial-owner confirmation and UBO register update (déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers – Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs (RBE)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Initial RBE filing within one month of RCS registration; any change in partnership interest, including a transfer creating or altering a 25% ownership or control threshold, must be filed within one month of the event; annual confirmation must be submitted once each calendar year to certify that the registered UBO data remains accurate.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance constitutes a criminal offence punishable by fines of up to EUR 1,250,000 and imprisonment; the RCS may also impose daily administrative fines and deregister the entity after repeated default.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual partnership direct-tax declaration (income/comprehensive tax return and net wealth tax declaration)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Administration des Contributions Directes (ACD), Luxembourg Direct Tax Administration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a calendar-year accounting period: the return is due by 31 December of the following year; extensions are granted on request. If the SCSp is classified as tax-transparent, the declaration reports the allocated share of income to the partners and supports their personal/corporate tax assessments.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalties up to EUR 5,000, a statutory late payment increase of 10%, monthly interest at 0.6% on outstanding taxes, and ex officio assessment by the ACD based on available records.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual VAT reconciliation return and intra-Community recapitulative statement (if the SCSp carries on taxable wholesale distribution)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT), Luxembourg VAT Administration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Monthly or quarterly VAT returns are due by the 15th day of the following month/period; the annual VAT return and the intra-Community sales listing, where applicable, must be filed no later than 31 January following the close of the calendar year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: VAT late-filing penalties and late payment interest of 0.6% per month; non-lodgement can lead to administrative tax assessment and recovery proceedings against the partnership and the responsible manager.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual statutory accounts deposit / publication in RCS (where the SCSp is subject to the annual accounts publication regime)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers – Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a calendar-year SCSp: partners' approval by 30 June and RCS filing within one month after approval, i.e. by 31 July; for a non-calendar year end: filing within one month of approval and no later than seven months after financial year end.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines up to EUR 10,000 and daily default penalties; continuing default may result in ex officio RCS deregistration and judicial dissolution; the managing general partner is personally liable for late filing.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A mandatory independent audit by a Luxembourg certified statutory auditor (réviseur d'entreprises agréé) is required for a SCSp that is a supervised alternative investment fund or UCI; exceeds two of the three medium-company thresholds for two consecutive financial years (total balance sheet EUR 17.5 million; net turnover EUR 35 million; average 250 employees) with reference to the consolidated or standalone figures; is required under the partnership agreement; or is requested by partners representing at least 10% of the partnership capital.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Luxembourg GAAP under the Law of 19 December 2002 on annual accounts and the Law of 10 August 1915 on commercial companies; IFRS as adopted by the EU is permitted for voluntary use and mandatory for consolidated accounts of listed/public-interest undertakings.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SCSp must keep an up-to-date register of beneficial owners at its registered office and must file initial UBO data with the Luxembourg RBE within one month of RCS registration. Thereafter, any shareholding or partnership-interest transfer affecting direct or indirect ownership of 25% or more, or any change in control rights, must be reported within one month. At least once per calendar year, the general partner or registered manager must re-file or confirm the RBE data electronically to maintain accuracy and good standing.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (register of general and limited partners and their capital interests)
Register of Directors/General Managers (register of gérants/managers and their authorities)
Minute Book (minutes of partner meetings, manager resolutions, and capital decisions)
Beneficial Owner Register (UBO register kept at the registered office in Luxembourg)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 2,800 – 7,500 per year for a standard Luxembourg registered-office and corporate-agent compliance package
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 8,000 – 28,000 per year for a certified independent audit of a small or medium-sized non-listed SCSp

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: SCSp is fiscally transparent: no entity-level CIT/municipal business tax on the SCSp itself; each partner is taxed on its distributive share. Luxembourg City combined headline for a resident corporate partner is 24.94% (CIT 17.00% + unemployment surcharge 1.19% + municipal business tax 6.75%). Key incentives available at partner level: 100% participation exemption on dividends and capital gains (>=10% or EUR 6 million cost, 12-month holding, taxable-subject condition); IP regime (80% exemption on net qualifying IP income yielding an effective rate of approx. 5%); digital transformation investment tax credit; notional interest deduction on new equity capital.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: No statutory time limit (unlimited); carryforward operates at the partner level for SCSp losses; Luxembourg anti-abuse rule may deny carryforward on a >25% change of ownership combined with a substantial change in business (Art. 114 LIR).
